name: LatePassenger
tagline: Anonymous electronic music from somewhere after midnight.
description: LatePassenger travels through an unnamed futuristic city, observes its streets, trains, windows, rain, neon lights and lonely places, and sends those memories to EuroWave Nights.
longDescription: Nobody knows who operates EuroWave Nights or who LatePassenger is. Transmitting from hidden frequencies after midnight, LatePassenger crafts nostalgic, high-energy, and melancholic electronic landscapes combining Eurobeat acceleration, Synthwave nocturnal atmospheres, G-Funk basslines, and Lo-Fi urban textures.
